description: India's national biometric identity document issued by UIDAI.

field_hints.aadhaar_number: 12-digit unique ID, often printed as XXXX XXXX XXXX or XXXX-XXXX-XXXX. Never starts with 0 or 1.
field_hints.full_name: Resident's full legal name as printed on the card, typically in Title Case.
field_hints.date_of_birth: Format is DD/MM/YYYY or Year of Birth (YOB). Convert to DD/MM/YYYY when possible.
field_hints.gender: One of: Male, Female, Transgender. May be abbreviated M/F/T.
field_hints.address: Full residential address as printed. May span multiple lines. Include locality, city, state, pincode.
field_hints.mobile_number: 10-digit Indian mobile number, may be partially masked (e.g. XXXXXXXX89).
field_hints.email: Email address if printed; usually masked partially.
field_hints.vid: 16-digit Virtual ID (VID) if printed on the card.
field_hints.issue_date: Date of card issue if printed.
